journal:
# Omar's BodyTracker journal (p03)

## Day 1 (Sun 2026-10-04)
- Setup screen was clear. Picked Moderately active (lifting 4x/week), BIA 21.2%, said "Yes" to eating the same for 2+ weeks (I do eat the same, but I JUST started lifting — the question didn't ask about that).
- After saving the profile, the dashboard showed weight 73.5 but Body Fat "—" even though I typed 21.2% in the profile. Expected it to show my BF.
- Tapping "Weight" opened a trend chart, not an add form. The add button is the separate "+ Weight" at the bottom. The button text reads weird to the screen reader ("+ + Weight Weight").
- Logged a full BIA entry (73.5 kg, 21.2%, fat 15.6, muscle 30.3). Recent entries then showed TWO entries for today: "weight 73.5" (made by the profile) and my "BIA 73.5 kg 21.2%". Deleted the profile one to avoid a duplicate. Mildly confusing that the profile silently creates a weigh-in.
- Tape form: waist has 1st/2nd/3rd readings (nice). Logged waist 85.4, neck 36.7, chest 96.4, arms 30.1/30.
- Nutrition: there's no "recomp" goal (lose fat + build muscle). Only Lose / Maintain / Gain. I picked Lose at 0.25%/wk (slowest suggested) as the closest thing. Target went 2,510 -> 2,340; protein 132 g (1.8 g/kg).
- "Explain the math" is great for a nerd like me (Katch-McArdle, Kalman filter, Hall 2008...). Also says "BIA readings are noisy" and "can't tell fat from muscle using calories alone" — honest.
- Protein card shows "— g / 132 g" even though I logged protein for 3 of 4 meals (21+8+25 = 54 g). I guess because the burger had no macros? Confusing — I'd rather see "54+ g".
- Day total line also stopped showing protein/carbs/fat once I added the burger with no macros ("Day total: 1607 kcal").
- Logged 4 meals, 2,960 kcal, ticked Day complete. That's ~600 over the 2,340 target... oops.

## Day 2 (Mon)
- Scale: 74.4 kg, 20.3%, muscle 28.8. Dashboard shows "Muscle Mass ▼ 1.5 kg" vs yesterday. Panicked for a second — lost 1.5 kg muscle overnight?? It's obviously scale noise but the dashboard just shows the red/down arrow without any "this is noise" hint on the tile itself.
- Body composition breakdown says "needs 3 readings at each end (6 total); have 1" — but I've logged 2 BIA readings (day 1 and day 2). Why 1? (screens/1790454754524.png)
- Nice: it gives a US Navy tape estimate of 17.7% BF from my tape. My scale says ~21%. Which one do I trust?
- 4 meals, 3,105 kcal, 104 g protein. Complete.

## Day 3 (Tue)
- Scale 74.4 kg, BF 22.7%, fat 16.9, muscle 30.3. "vs Last": weight 0 kg but fat mass ▲1.8 kg AND muscle ▲1.5 kg. Physically impossible — my scale is a random number generator. The app at least offers "vs First / vs Last" toggles.
- New: every meal today got "Macros add up to ~890 kcal (20% from the logged calories). One of the numbers may be off." Every single meal is off by exactly 20%?? I typed the numbers straight from my app/labels. I don't know which number is wrong, and the app doesn't tell me which to trust or what to do. Also shows as a banner on the Nutrition page for the whole day.
- 4 meals, 2,823 kcal, complete.

## Day 4 (Wed)
- Found the ⚙ on the Body page = "Set goals" (target weight / target BF). Set target BF 15%, left weight blank (I want to recomp, not really lose weight).
- After that the Body Fat tile says "0% → 15%" in green. I read it as "body fat from 0% to 15%"?? I think it means 0% progress toward 15% goal. Confusing wording. Meanwhile the Weight ring is a FULL blue circle although I set no weight goal (screens/1790454858053.png).
- Weight tile shows "▲ 0.8 kg" in red — red for gaining is judgemental when I'm trying to build muscle.
- Breakdown still says "have 1" reading after 4 BIA weigh-ins.
- The 20%-off macro warning from yesterday is still pinned at the top of Nutrition.
- Avg intake 2,921 vs target 2,340 and maintenance 2,510. So I'm eating ~400 over maintenance. Protein 94 g avg vs 132 g target. Waiting for the Sunday update before changing anything.

## Day 5 (Thu)
- Scale: 74.6 kg, BF 25.6% (!), fat mass 19.1. Dashboard: Fat Mass ▲3.5 kg vs first. 3.5 kg of fat in 4 days eating ~2,900/day is impossible. No warning/"noisy reading" flag on the tile. The weight chart smooths and greys out outliers, but the Fat Mass chart (tap the tile) just joins the raw dots with a curvy line, so it looks like a real spike (screens/1790454904935.png).
- 4 meals, 2,735 kcal, 80 g protein. Complete.

## Day 6 (Fri)
- 73.8 kg, 23.3%. Lunch kabsa with no macros again — the day's protein total disappears ("Day total: 2823 kcal", no protein) even though 56 g is known. The avg protein just skips the day.
- 4 meals, 2,823 kcal. Complete. Avg intake ~2,873. Still waiting for Sunday's update.

## Day 7 (Sat)
- 73.3 kg but BIA says 26.6% BF / fat 19.5 kg (▲3.9 kg vs first) and muscle ▼1.5 kg. If I believed this I'd quit the gym. Weight trend is flat at 73.8.
- Carbs/fat card shows "514 g carbs | 113 g fat" — that's exactly day 3's total (the only day where every meal had full macros). It's not labelled as "1 day", so it looks like I eat 514 g carbs a day on average. Protein card at least says "average of 5 complete day(s) with protein logged".
- 4 meals, 2,093 kcal (lighter day). 7/7 days complete.

## Week 1 (checked Sat day 7; the app only refreshes on Sunday)
- App shows: maintenance 2,510 ± 590 kcal/day, "Estimated, 0% from your data". Target 2,340 (lose 0.25%/wk). Recommendation: "Suggested intake 2,340. On-track check needs 14 days". Warnings: the day-3 macro mismatch; protein 84 g vs 132 g target. kg/week "needs data".
- Body comp: "Not enough data yet" (needs 3 readings at each end, 21 days apart). Tape estimate 17.7% BF.
- What I understand: I eat ~2,760/day, ~250 above the formula maintenance, ~420 above my target. And I'm way short on protein (84 vs 132 g). The ±590 range is huge though, so the "maintenance" is basically a guess from my profile right now.
- Decision: wait for tomorrow's Sunday update before changing food.

## Day 8 (Sun) — first weekly update
- Tape: waist 85.7 (▲0.3), neck 37.5, chest 96.3, arms 30.6/30.4 (arms up ~0.5 cm!). Tape tiles show ▲/▼ vs first — nice. BIA muscle now shows ▼3.1 kg vs first. Ugh.
- Update: maintenance 2,550 ± 550 (Estimated, 13% from my data), target 2,380, avg intake 2,729, trend +0.22 kg/week (95%: -0.41 to +0.85).
- Explain-the-math cross-check says the straight-line slope is -41.7 g/day (losing) while the filter says +0.22 kg/wk (gaining) — opposite signs, but it says they "agree" because the ± is huge. Also the regression says it covers "2026-09-14 → 2026-10-11" though I only started 10-04.
- Noticed BMR in the math dropped 1,621 -> 1,568 — because it uses the mean of my last 3 BIA fat readings, which jumped. So my noisy scale moves my calorie numbers a bit.
- Decision (plan): eat ~2,400/day from tomorrow and push protein. The app convinced me: I'm ~350 over target and 50 g short on protein.

## Days 9–15 (routine via my script live.mjs; it still taps/types everything in the app)
- Even after I planned 2,400, some days came out 2,700 (day 9, day 11) and some 1,900 (days 12–13). Real life.
- Nothing new popped up during the week. Macro warning for 10-06 finally dropped off after 14 days.
- Carbs/fat card stuck at "347 | 83" all week (probably again a single day with full macros), no label saying how many days.

## Week 2 (Sun day 15, 2026-10-18)
- App: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.78 to +0.47 kg/week) includes your target of −0.18 kg/week. Suggested intake 2,370." Maintenance 2,550 ± 500 (Estimated, 27% from my data). Avg intake 2,342. Trend −0.15 kg/wk.
- Protein target silently DROPPED from 133 g to 116 g. Explain-the-math: "Reference weight 64.6 kg: body fat 25.6% is above 25%, so lean mass 54.9 kg ÷ 0.85 is used." That 25.6% is the average of my last 3 BIA readings (28%, 25.9%, 23%) — the same scale that swings 5% in a day. Last week it was below 25% so it used 73.8 kg. So one crazy BIA morning changed my protein target by 17 g. Meanwhile the app's own tape estimate says 16.6% BF. Feels inconsistent (screens/1790455313942.png).
- Body comp breakdown: "needs 3 readings at each end (6 total); have 3" after 15 BIA weigh-ins. Still not sure what it's counting. Tape estimate now 16.6%. Waist 84.7 (▼0.7 vs first), right arm 31.4.
- Dashboard: muscle ▼2.7 kg vs first, fat ▲1.3 kg. If I trusted the tiles I'd think lifting is making me fatter and weaker. The waist tape says the opposite.
- Decision: plan 2,370 (on track), try to eat more protein.

## Days 16–22 (script)
- Quiet week, nothing new popped up. Intake bounced 1,960–2,716. Protein stuck ~75–86 g avg vs 116 g target — the app just repeats the number, no tips on how to hit it.

## Week 3 (Sun day 22, 2026-10-25)
- App: "On track. Estimated rate (−0.86 to +0.36 kg/wk) includes target −0.18. Suggested 2,360." Maintenance 2,530 ± 500, 29% from data, Estimated. Avg intake 2,442, trend −0.25 kg/wk. Protein 86 / 116 g (reference weight 64.5 kg because BIA avg BF 25.8% > 25%).
- BIA this morning: 30.6% BF, fat mass 22.5 → dashboard says Fat Mass ▲6.9 kg vs first!! Weight is ▼0.1 kg. The app shows this with a red arrow and no caveat on the tile (screens/1790455547172.png). Tape waist 86.0 (up 0.6), chest 93.7 (down 2.7?) — my taping is sloppy too.
- Breakdown: "needs 3 readings at each end (6 total); have 4". I finally get it: it's counting my weekly TAPE entries (4 Sundays), not my 22 BIA weigh-ins. The text says "readings from the same source" which made me think BIA. Should say "tape measurements".
- Navy tape estimate 18.6% (vs BIA 30.6% today). 12 points apart.
- Decision: plan 2,360, keep lifting, keep trying for more protein.

## Days 23–29 (script)
- Quiet. Avg intake ~2,450 even though I "planned" 2,360. Protein crept up to ~90–97 g.

## Week 4 (Sun day 29, 2026-11-01)
- App: "On track (−0.46 to +0.65 kg/wk). Suggested 2,400." Maintenance 2,570 ± 450, 43% from data, still Estimated. Avg intake 2,319 (7-day). Trend +0.10 kg/wk.
- Protein target jumped BACK to 133 g (last 3 BIA averaged under 25% again). So my protein target has gone 132 → 133 → 116 → 116 → 133 depending on the scale's mood. Confusing; I didn't change anything.
- Body comp breakdown finally shows a table: "Confidence: medium — No measurable change yet. Changes are within the measurement noise." Fat mass BIA 15.9 → 16.9 (±1.5), muscle 29.8 → 28.6 (±1.5, "low confidence, BIA muscle includes water"), BF 21.4 → 22.9% (±2), weight 74.1 → 73.6. This is the most useful screen in the app for me — it calms me down vs the scary red arrows on the dashboard tiles.
- POSSIBLE BUG: same screen says "No waist data to cross-check against; add tape measurements for a stronger signal." I have logged waist 5 Sundays in a row (85.4, 85.7, 84.7, 86.0, 84.3). Probably it means "not enough waist readings 21 days apart yet", but it literally tells me to add tape measurements I already add (screens/1790455749298.png).
- Decision: plan 2,400.

## Days 30–36 (script)
- Day 31: banner "It's been 30+ days since your last backup. Your data lives only on this device. Back up now | Later" — my script ignored it during the batch; I handled it on Sunday.
- Hmm: "30+ days since your last backup" when I've NEVER backed up (the data screen says "Last backup: never"). Minor wording.

## Week 5 (Sun day 36, 2026-11-08)
- Tapped "Back up now" -> "Your data" screen: 36 weigh-ins, 6 measurement entries, 144 food entries, 36 complete days. "Persistent storage: not granted by the browser" (no idea what I should do about that). Full backup JSON downloaded fine.
- App: maintenance 2,620 ± 380 — label switched to **Measured** (60% from my data). Target 2,450, "On track (−0.62 to +0.16 kg/wk)". Avg intake 2,444, trend −0.23 kg/wk. Protein 82 / 133 g.
- Breakdown now includes waist: "Waist, tape only 85.3 → 85.4 cm (±1), no measurable change". Fat mass BIA 15.9 → 16.7, muscle 29.8 → 30.3, BF 21.4 → 22.7%. "No measurable change yet… Based on your waist trend (the most reliable fat signal here)." The "No waist data" message from last week is gone.
- What I think: 5 weeks of logging, "on track" every week, and literally nothing changed. "On track" feels too easy — the rate range (−0.62 to +0.16) includes zero, so I'd be "on track" even at maintenance. The app never talks about recomp / building muscle; it only knows lose/maintain/gain.
- Decision: changed goal to lose 0.5%/wk (target became 2,270) and plan 2,270. Still under-eating protein; the app just shows the gap.

## Days 37–43 (script) — nothing new popped up.

## Week 6 (Sun day 43, 2026-11-15)
- App: maintenance 2,700 ± 270 (Measured, 79% from data). Target 2,360 (lose 0.5%/wk). "On track (−0.67 to −0.12 kg/wk) includes target −0.37." Avg intake 2,259, trend −0.40 kg/wk. Protein 84 / 132 g.
- Funny: my maintenance keeps going up as it learns (2,510 → 2,550 → 2,530 → 2,570 → 2,620 → 2,700), so the suggested intake went UP (2,270 → 2,360) even though I just asked to lose faster. Makes sense after reading the math, but a normal person would be confused.
- Dashboard summary card now reads "Body composition medium confidence — No measurable change yet". Body Fat tile: "10% → 15%" (today's BIA happened to be low 20.6%). Muscle ▼1.4 kg vs first on the tile, but breakdown says muscle −0.3 kg ± 1.5 = no change. Tiles vs breakdown tell different stories.
- Breakdown: waist 85.3 → 85.1 (no change), weight 74.1 → 72.9 (−1.2 kg). So I'm losing weight but waist hasn't moved yet.
- Decision: plan 2,360.

## Days 44–50 (script) — nothing new popped up. Lowest weigh-in 71.6 (day 46).

## Week 7 (Sun day 50, 2026-11-22)
- App: maintenance 2,700 ± 230 (Measured, 85%). Target 2,370. "On track (−0.68 to −0.22 kg/wk) includes target −0.36." Avg intake 2,331, trend −0.45 kg/wk. Protein 83 / 131 g.
- Breakdown: waist 85.3 → 84.9 (−0.3, "no measurable change", noise ±1), fat mass BIA 15.9 → 15.1, BF 21.4 → 20.7%, weight 74.1 → 72.7 (−1.4 kg). Tape Navy estimate 16%. Waist this morning 83.7 — lowest yet.
- My protein has been ~80–90 g for 7 weeks no matter what the app says. The app shows the gap every day but never suggests anything concrete (e.g. "add a 30 g protein snack"). I'd have liked that.
- Decision: plan 2,370.

## Days 51–57 (script) — nothing new popped up. Lowest weigh-in 70.9 (day 52).

## Week 8 (Sun day 57, 2026-11-29)
- App: maintenance 2,800 ± 200 (Measured, 89%). Target 2,460. "On track (−0.67 to −0.24 kg/wk) includes target −0.36." Avg intake 2,534, trend −0.46 kg/wk. Protein 88 / 130 g.
- Body comp headline flipped to "Losing fat (medium confidence) — Fat signals are down; muscle has no measurable change." 
- POSSIBLE BUG / contradiction in the same table (screens/1790456545676.png): Waist 85.3 → 84.2 "−1 cm" (noise ±1) is counted as a real drop, but BIA Body fat 21.4 → 23.7 = **+2.3% (noise ±2)** — that's a measurable INCREASE by the app's own rule, shown in the same blue colour as the waist drop — and fat mass +1.1 kg. So "fat signals are down" is only true for the waist; the BIA fat signal is UP. I'd expect "mixed signals" or at least the BIA row flagged as contradicting. (I actually believe the tape more than my scale, but the app shouldn't say "signals are down" when one is up past its noise.)
- Dashboard tile still says Fat Mass ▲0.5 kg and Body Fat "0% → 15%" at the same time as the card says "Losing fat". 
- Decision: plan 2,460. Feeling good — weight down 2.3 kg, waist finally moving.

## Days 58–64 (script) — nothing new popped up.

## Week 9 (Sun day 64, 2026-12-06)
- App: maintenance 2,780 ± 180 (Measured, 91%). Target 2,440. On track (−0.51 to −0.12 kg/wk vs target −0.36). Avg intake 2,467, trend −0.32 kg/wk. Protein 79 / 130 g.
- Breakdown: "Losing fat" — waist 85.3 → 83.8 (−1.4 cm, beyond ±1 noise). BIA BF +1.9% (just under ±2 so now "no measurable change"), fat mass +0.9, muscle −0.4 (no change). Weight −2.3 kg.
- My take: waist down 1.5 cm, weight down 2.3 kg, arms about the same. That's a small cut, not really a recomp — I don't think I built muscle (protein never got close to target). The app can't tell me either way ("can't tell fat from muscle using calories alone").
- Decision: plan 2,440.

## Days 65–71 (script)
- Day 65 BIA said 16.8% BF (lowest ever), next day 23%. lol.
- Day 66: backup banner again ("30+ days since your last backup") — correct this time (last backup 11-08). Made a second backup on Sunday.

## Week 10 (Sun day 71, 2026-12-13)
- App: maintenance 2,680 ± 170 (Measured, 91%) — first time it went DOWN (from 2,780). Target 2,340. On track (−0.41 to −0.03 kg/wk). Avg 2,396, trend −0.22 kg/wk. Protein 78 / 130 g.
- Breakdown: Losing fat — waist 85.3 → 83.9 (−1.3), BIA fat/muscle/BF all "no measurable change". Weight −2.0 kg.
- "On track" when the range is −0.41 to −0.03 and the target is −0.36 — technically yes, but my weight has been flat ~72 for 3 weeks. It never says "you're drifting".
- Decision: plan 2,340.

## Days 72–78 (script) — nothing new popped up. Day 76 was a 3,017 kcal day.

## Week 11 (Sun day 78, 2026-12-20)
- App: maintenance 2,610 ± 170 (Measured, 92%) — falling for the 2nd week (2,780 → 2,680 → 2,610). Target 2,270. "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.38 kg to +0 kg per week) includes your target of −0.36." Avg 2,328, trend −0.19 kg/wk. Protein 80 / 130 g.
- "+0 kg per week" is a weird way to write 0. And the target (−0.36) is right at the edge of the range — calling that "On track" is generous; I've been flat around 72 kg for a month.
- Breakdown: "Losing fat" — waist 85.3 → 83.5 (−1.7 cm), everything BIA "no measurable change". Waist this morning 82.5 — best yet!
- Decision: plan 2,270.

## Days 79–84 (script) — nothing new popped up. Day 84: 70.4 kg (lowest), waist last measured 82.5.

## Week 12 (Sat day 84 — no Sunday update before the end)
- App (from the 12-20 update): maintenance 2,610 ± 170 Measured 92%, target 2,270, "On track (−0.38 to +0)", avg 2,292, trend −0.19 kg/wk, protein 89 / 130 g.
- Body: "Losing fat (medium confidence)". Waist 85.3 → 83.5 (first-3 vs last-3). Weight ▼3.1 kg vs first. Muscle ▼1.3 kg on the tile, "no measurable change" in the breakdown.

## End: backup & export
- ⇩ icon -> "Your data": 84 weigh-ins, 12 measurement entries, 336 food entries, 84 complete days. Full backup JSON downloaded (backup-2026-12-26.json: 96 entries = 84 weigh-ins + 12 tape, 336 food, settings, goals). 
- "Daily data export … for spreadsheets or analysis" but the only button is "Export daily data (JSON)". I can't open JSON in Excel/Sheets. Expected CSV here. (There are separate Weights/Food/Measurements CSVs, which is what I'd actually use.)
- Daily export: 84 days, nice clean per-day records. But protein is missing on 34 of 84 days — any day with one meal without macros drops the whole day's protein, even the known part.
- Weights CSV "time" column is UTC ("2026-10-04T03:50:00.000Z") — I weighed at 06:50 local. Looks like the wrong time at first glance.

## Final review
What helped: the "Explain the math" page is honestly the best thing — I could see exactly how maintenance, target and protein were computed. The body-composition breakdown (first 3 vs last 3, with a ± noise column) was the only thing keeping me sane with my BIA scale; it said "no measurable change" when the dashboard tiles were screaming "+6.9 kg fat". Maintenance moving from "Estimated" to "Measured" after ~5 weeks, with the ± shrinking from 590 to 170, felt legit. The weekly-only updates stopped me obsessing daily.
What confused me: no recomp goal (I'm skinny fat and lifting — I want fat down, muscle up); the dashboard tiles show raw BIA swings with red/green arrows while the breakdown says it's noise; my protein target flipped between 116 and 133 g because of the scale; "0% → 15%" on the body-fat tile; "have 1 / have 3" counting tape entries when I thought it meant BIA readings; "No waist data" when I had 5 waist entries; "Losing fat — fat signals are down" while the BIA body-fat row showed +2.3% (beyond its ±2). "On track" every single week even when I was flat for a month.
Complaints: the app tells me every day I'm ~45 g short on protein but never helps me close it. Dropping a whole day's protein because one meal had no macros. JSON for a "spreadsheet" export.
Would I keep using it? Maybe — probably yes for weight + waist + calories, but I'd stop typing my BIA fat/muscle numbers into it, they only make the dashboard scarier.

# p03 — Omar (22, skinny fat, BIA scale, lifting 4x/week) — final reply

## 1. Usage
- Used the app on all 84 days (2026-10-04 → 2026-12-26).
- Meals logged: 336 (4 a day). Days marked complete: 84/84. Weigh-ins: 84, all with BIA body fat, fat mass and muscle mass. Tape: 12 (weekly, Sundays).
- Days 1–7 were done by hand. Days 8–84 used my script `live.mjs`, which still taps and types everything. I did a check-in and set a plan every Sunday. I made backups on 11-08, 12-13 and 12-26.

## 2. Weekly table
| week (day) | maintenance shown | target | label | recommendation | what I did |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## 3. Confusions
- Profile: the body fat I typed during setup (21.2%) did not appear on the dashboard. Saving the profile also quietly created a separate weigh-in, which gave me two entries on day 1.
- Dashboard: tapping the "Weight" tile opens a chart. Adding a weigh-in is the separate "+ Weight" button.
- Nutrition goal: there are only Lose, Maintain and Gain. There is no recomp option (lose fat and gain muscle at the same time).
- Food log: if one meal has no macros, the whole day's protein and macros disappear (for example, "Day total: 1607 kcal" with no protein shown). The protein card showed "— g" on day 1 even though 54 g was known.
- Carbs/fat card: it showed "514 g | 113 g", which was a single day's total. Nothing said it was based on only 1 day.
- Macro warning on day 3: every meal was "20% off", but it didn't say which number to trust or what to do.
- Dashboard tiles: they show raw BIA day-to-day changes with red arrows ("Fat Mass ▲6.9 kg", "Muscle ▼3.1 kg") and no noise warning. The breakdown screen says the same changes are just noise.
- Body Fat tile: "0% → 15%" reads like "from 0% body fat to 15%". The Weight ring showed as a full circle even though I never set a weight goal.
- Breakdown: "needs 3 readings at each end…; have 1/3/4". It was counting weekly tape entries, not my daily BIA readings, and the wording didn't say so.
- Protein target: it changed from 133 to 116 and back to 133 g because the average of my last 3 BIA readings crossed 25% body fat. The app's own tape estimate said about 17%.
- "On track": it said this every week, even when the range included zero and my weight was flat for a month. It also printed "+0 kg per week".
- Backup banner: it said "30+ days since your last backup" when I had never made one.
- Export: the "Daily data export … for spreadsheets" only comes as JSON. The time column in the Weights CSV is in UTC (03:50Z) instead of my local time (06:50).

## 4. Possible bugs
1. **"No waist data" while waist data exists.** On day 29 I opened Body → "Tap for the full breakdown". I had 5 weekly waist entries.
   - Expected: something like "not enough waist readings yet".
   - Actual: "No waist data to cross-check against; add tape measurements for a stronger signal."
   - Screenshot: `screens/1790455749298.png`
2. **"Losing fat — Fat signals are down" while the BIA body-fat row shows a measurable increase.** Seen on day 57 in the breakdown.
   - Expected: mixed signals, or the BIA row flagged as disagreeing.
   - Actual: Waist was −1 cm (noise ±1), counted as a real drop. BIA body fat was 21.4 → 23.7 = **+2.3% (noise ±2)**, shown in the same blue as the waist, plus fat mass +1.1 kg. The headline still said "Fat signals are down".
   - Screenshot: `screens/1790456545676.png`
3. **Protein target driven by noisy BIA readings.**
   - Week 2 and 3: "Reference weight 64.6 kg: body fat 25.6% is above 25%…", giving 116 g.
   - Week 1 and 4 onward: trend weight was used, giving 133 g.
   - Nothing I changed caused this. Screenshot: `screens/1790455313942.png`
4. **Regression cross-check on day 8 is odd.**
   - It says the window is "2026-09-14 → 2026-10-11", but my data starts on 10-04.
   - Its slope (−41.7 g/day) has the opposite sign to the filter's +0.22 kg/week, yet it is reported as "agrees".
5. **Minor: dropped protein.** Any day with one no-macro meal loses its whole protein total, both in the averages and in the daily export (34 of 84 days have no protein in the export).

## 5. Review
The math page and the "first 3 vs last 3 ± noise" breakdown are really good. They're the only reason I didn't panic about my jumpy BIA scale. Watching maintenance go from "Estimated ±590" to "Measured ±170" felt trustworthy. But the dashboard tiles show every scale swing like it's real, the app has no idea what a recomp is, and it tells me every day I'm 45 g short on protein without ever helping me fix it. I lost about 3 kg and 2 cm off my waist, which is fine, but I'll stop entering my BIA fat and muscle numbers.

**Would keep using: maybe.**
